facts.subject: vehicle:configuration
facts.value: U.S. 2004 9-5 Arc four-door, factory B235L 2.3T and five-speed automatic, original configuration as decoded from user-provided plate VIN
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Actual installed engine/transmission and title identity are unverified. Do not publish full VIN.

facts.subject: body:front-structure
facts.value: The 2004 WIS forward frame-member partial repair limits sectioning of inner member to max 330 mm and centre member to max 270 mm from front edge
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: NOT a general rust repair limit or automatically relevant to visible posterior frame damage.

facts.subject: body:front-structure
facts.value: Full front frame-member/wheelhouse repair requires alignment bench measurement; some joints require MIG brazing rather than conventional welding
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Cannot approve specific corroded shell without physical assessment.

facts.subject: body:front-structure
facts.value: Factory documents repair of rear nut piece holding front subframe through a floor access plug
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Nut repair does not restore perforated underlying structure.

facts.subject: front:subframe
facts.value: 2004 petrol subframe service requires engine/radiator/steering support, subframe alignment; main fasteners 100 Nm plus 45 degrees; middle bolts have distinct heads and washers
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Not an instruction to work under an unstable shell or reuse compromised fasteners.

facts.subject: front:brakes
facts.value: 2004 MY B235L B2 brakes are listed with front disc diameter 308 mm and rear 300 mm
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Verify actual rotor diameter/hardware because parts may have been changed.

facts.subject: front:subframe
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Correct old-year donor is a better lead, but no approval for a replacement before installed part, mounting condition, rust and geometry check.

facts.subject: transmission:automatic
facts.value: Saab MY2004 automatic specifies mineral-based Saab 3309 ATF; Toyota documentation identifies Toyota T-IV with JWS3309
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Specification cross-brand consumable candidate; check exact bottle and gearbox, not a permission to interchange complete transmissions.

facts.subject: body:outer-rocker
facts.value: Klokkerholm 6526012 markets 4-door right outer rocker repair panel for original 9-5 model family; Key Parts 65-26-01-2 likewise claims 1998–2009 fit
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Outside rocker skins do not replace structural inner sill or mounting reinforcement; compare profiles before purchase.

facts.subject: engine:pcv
facts.value: The ProParts 21341200 / Saab 55561200 PCV kit is listed for 9-5 1998–2003 and old 9-3; the 2004–2009 9-5 has separately listed PCV-system parts
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Do not buy early PCV upgrade kit for this 2004 B235L without routing and OE confirmation.

facts.subject: front:brakes
facts.value: Supplier advertises 308 mm EBC rotor alternatives against both 9-5 and original 9-3 Viggen; useful cross-Saab replacement lead
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Verify physical rotor, axle and exact 2004 B2 installed configuration. Not a cross-GM donor claim.

facts.subject: body:lifting
facts.value: Factory lifting locations include front towing-eye/subframe area and rocker jack brackets and expressly exclude rear axle/spare wheel well
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Heavily corroded actual lift/support points may be unsafe notwithstanding factory locations.

facts.subject: engine:timing-chain
facts.value: Saab documents in-car timing/balancer chain work for the 2004 petrol four-cylinder
facts.locator: See cited model-year WIS page or supplier catalog
facts.notes: Procedure exists; no evidence this high-mileage individual engine needs timing-chain replacement.

parts.title: 2002–2005 OG 9-5 front subframe catalogue assembly
requirements: Confirm original assembly stamp, correct support and mounting geometry, actual body metal condition, freight and clean donor condition
parts.notes: Retailer separately lists 12765948 for 2006–2009; no GM/Opel plug-and-play donor proven.

parts.title: Key Parts right outer rocker repair panel for original 9-5
requirements: Confirm four-door external panel profile and availability
Inspect inner sill, reinforcements and attachment points before body repair
parts.notes: Outer cover replacement is not structural frame repair.

parts.title: EBC 308 mm front brake rotor set (seller's 9-5 / OG 9-3 Viggen catalogue)
requirements: Measure installed rotor 308 mm and identify B2 calipers, hub details and correct left/right hardware
parts.notes: Shared Saab-family aftermarket catalogue, not an Opel/GM donor.

parts.title: Earlier Saab PCV kit (not approved for 2004 B235L)

relationships.conditions: Supplier early 1998–2003 9-5 PCV diagram; NOT a verified 2004 replacement

requirements: Do not purchase for 2004 based on B235 family alone; retrieve correct 2004 breather configuration and stamps
parts.notes: Explicit exclusion lead; old catalog lists earlier models.
